gaps.sentence: The plane takes ___ in ten minutes.
gaps.explanation: take off = leave the ground (plane); also remove clothes; become successful (career took off).

gaps.sentence: She ___ down an offer from a rival university.
The match was called ___ because of the storm.
She was brought ___ by her grandparents.
gaps.explanation: bring up a child = raise, educate them.
pick up = learn without formal study; also collect (pick somebody up).

gaps.sentence: The protesters set ___ at dawn from the village square.
gaps.explanation: set off/out = begin a journey; set up = establish.

gaps.sentence: Put ___ your toys when you've finished playing.
gaps.explanation: put away = put something in its usual place.
